*My Opinion: Basis of Differentiation is the Most Important Component*

In my opinion, out of the three components of core strategy, *basis of differentiation* is the most important one for Consumer Banking.

*Argument 1:* Nowadays, almost every bank is offering the same products like savings accounts, debit cards, and mobile banking. A customer will only choose a bank that gives him something different and better, like low charges, fast service, or a user-friendly mobile app. If there is no differentiation, the customer has no reason to stay with one bank.

*Argument 2:* Every bank has a mission and a product scope, but it is differentiation that gives a bank a unique identity in the market. It is the main thing that keeps a bank ahead of its competitors and creates loyal customers. Without differentiation, a bank will only get stuck in a price war, which is not profitable in the long run.

So, in my view, for success in Consumer Banking, it is most important for a bank to prove itself different from others.
